# WayfindingCard

Displays route-planning content with an optional close action. Localize `closeLabel` when providing `onClose`. `WayfindingInputRow` supports `originLabel`, `destinationLabel` and `swapLabel`; placeholders are hints, not replacements for those accessible names. Navigation actions do not submit a surrounding form.

- **Import:** `import { WayfindingCard, WayfindingInputRow } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Components
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/components-wayfindingcard--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import {
  ThemeProvider,
  WayfindingCard,
  WayfindingInputRow,
} from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function WayfindingCardExample() {
  const [origin, setOrigin] = useState("Current Location");
  const [dest, setDest] = useState("Gate 42");
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <WayfindingCard
        onClose={() => alert("Close Event")}
        className="w-full max-w-[360px]"
      >
        <WayfindingInputRow
          originValue={origin}
          onOriginChange={setOrigin}
          destinationValue={dest}
          onDestinationChange={setDest}
          onSwap={() => {
            setOrigin(dest);
            setDest(origin);
          }}
        />
      </WayfindingCard>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## WayfindingCard

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `WayfindingCardProps`, which extends `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>`.

- `title`: `string`, optional, default `"Navigation"`.
- `onClose`: `() => void`, optional.
- `closeLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Close navigation"`.
- `children`: `React.ReactNode`, **required**.

It also takes the 262 attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## WayfindingInputRow

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `WayfindingInputRowProps`, which extends `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>`.

- `originValue`: `string`, optional.
- `onOriginChange`: `(val: string) => void`, optional.
- `destinationValue`: `string`, optional.
- `onDestinationChange`: `(val: string) => void`, optional.
- `onSwap`: `() => void`, optional.
- `originPlaceholder`: `string`, optional, default `"Choose starting point..."`.
- `destinationPlaceholder`: `string`, optional, default `"Choose destination..."`.
- `originLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Origin"`.
- `destinationLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Destination"`.
- `swapLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Swap origin and destination"`.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the 263 attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
